Pension: retirement benefit asset £11.6m vs obligation £4.0m (net surplus); remeasurement gain £2.3m (net of tax); cash contributions above IAS 19 charge £2.4m (ir_b9e18372b456fd3b.txt).
Inventories £395.2m (2024: £381.8m); trade and other receivables £342.7m (2024: £300.0m); working capital decrease £12.0m in operating cash flow (ir_b9e18372b456fd3b.txt).

Goodwill £659.1m at 31 Dec 2025; segment reorganisation to Island of Ireland, Great Britain, Northern Europe, Iberia from 1 Oct 2025; impairment review flagged limited headroom in former UK Distribution CGUs (ir_b9e18372b456fd3b.txt).

Segment revenue FY2025: Island of Ireland £1,071.6m (+5.4%), Great Britain £765.4m (−0.2%), Northern Europe £469.7m (+0.1%), Iberia £212.9m (vs £29.7m; Salvador Escoda acquired 30 Oct 2024) (ir_b9e18372b456fd3b.txt).
Segment adjusted operating profit*: IoI £111.0m, GB £49.2m, Northern Europe £29.6m, Iberia £13.6m; central costs £19.1m; property profit £5.9m (ir_b9e18372b456fd3b.txt).
Great Britain average daily LFL revenue +0.4%; LFL overheads +1.8%. Near-term UK construction outlook subdued; medium term positive on housing delivery (ir_b9e18372b456fd3b.txt).

Chair outlook: diversified segments position group to leverage growth in Island of Ireland and Iberia while preparing for recovery in weaker markets; cyclical industry with investment-grade leverage discipline (ir_b9e18372b456fd3b.txt).
